I found the dock (DK-200 is in stock, new), but I need your confirmation before I place the order, because I don't have a record of which monitor the design team standardised on. The catalog shows two in-stock, new monitors:

- **MN-27** – 27-inch 4K Monitor, $329 each
- **MN-32** – 32-inch 5K Monitor, $529 each
